input.request: Mira wants to increase her monthly standing order to the fictional Westmere Garden Cooperative from £42.00 to £68.00. She has not yet authorised the change.

events.text: Standing order to Westmere Garden Cooperative: £42.00 per month.
I want to increase this standing order to £68.00 a month. The portal still shows £42.00, and I haven’t confirmed a change yet.
I checked that Mira is the verified owner of this standing order and may amend it. Her chat request is not authorisation, so the order remains unchanged until she confirms in the secure portal.
I’ve sent the change from £42.00 to £68.00 per month for your confirmation in this session. I have not changed the standing order.
I confirm the change to £68.00 per month for my standing order to Westmere Garden Cooperative.

summary: Mira Ellery, a verified customer on the secure portal, asked to raise her standing order to Westmere Garden Cooperative from £42.00 to £68.00 a month and confirmed the change. The desk refused a preliminary ask of the recurring system, since a change request is not allowed that step, then submitted the request, and a request about the standing order was registered with the recurring team and the case closed as REQUESTED. The record does not show the standing order itself being changed, so that remains with the recurring team.
